signal: RouteMate released version 2.0 of its mobile app in February 2026 and showed up at TMC 2026 to push its AI dashcam and predictive dispatch lineup

email.body1:
Philip, saw RouteMate ship the 2.0 mobile app and show the AI dashcam and predictive dispatch lineup at TMC.

A product and event push like that usually surfaces more fleet accounts than the team can cover before reps ramp, and that is where pipeline goes cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for RouteMate off your product and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Philip, quick follow-up for RouteMate.

Coming out of a launch and a conference, the pipeline target moves faster than headcount can. Most sales managers don't actually know how many meetings the team needs to book to hit the number, so the gap shows up late.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings RouteMate needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Philip, last bit of proof for RouteMate.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how RouteMate's reply rate likely compares to other logistics-tech teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Philip, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Following a launch and a conference is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I'll tailor it to RouteMate either way.
